_help: Controls the top-right button on baissourcountryclub.com. season: 'closed' = red 'Closed for winter' on every page, ignores hours. season: 'open' = automatic from hours (Beirut time): green when open, orange within closing_soon_minutes of closing, red when closed. Hours are 24h 'HH:MM' pairs per day; a day with [] is closed; leave all days empty to keep the plain green button.
